'''Andrzej Marek Kossakowski''' (20 February 1938 – 31 January 2021) was a Polish theoretical [[physicist]] and a professor at the [[Nicolaus Copernicus University]]. He was best known for his work on [[open quantum system]]s.

==Education==
Andrzej Kossakowski was born on 20 February 1938 in Lwów, Poland (now [[Lviv]], in [[Ukraine]]).<ref name="spr">''Sprawozdania Towarzystwa Naukowego w Toruniu. Tom 26. 1 I 1972 - 31 XII 1972'', wyd. PWN, Warszawa-Poznań 1974, s. 129-130</ref> He attended a primary and secondary school in [[Sopot]].<ref name="spr"/><ref name="pr">''Pracownicy nauki i dydaktyki Uniwersytetu Mikołaja Kopernika 1945-1994. Materiały do biografii'', wyd. UMK, Toruń 1995, s. 358</ref>

In the years 1955-1960, he studied physics at the [[Nicolaus Copernicus University]] in [[Toruń]]. Right after graduation, he got a job at the same university, first as an assistant, then as a senior assistant in 1962.<ref name="pr"/> In 1966, he defended his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD thesis]] titled ''On the entropy increase law in informational thermodynamics of density operators'', written under the supervision of [[Roman Stanisław Ingarden]] during the scientific internship in the Institute of Theoretical Physics at the [[University of Wrocław]] in the academic year 1964/1965.<ref name="spr"/><ref name="pr"/>

==Academic career==
In 1967, Kossakowski was employed at the [[Nicolaus Copernicus University]] as an [[assistant professor]].<ref name="pr"/> In 1971, he was [[Habilitation|habilitated]] with a thesis titled ''Informational decision scheme in statistical quantum mechanics''.<ref name="spr"/><ref name="pr"/> He was promoted to [[docent]] in 1972,<ref name="spr"/><ref name="pr"/> and after three years he became an associate director of the Institute of Physics in didactics.<ref>{{cite web|title=FIZYKA NA UMK: KALENDARIUM (szkic projektowanego tekstu opracował prof. Józef Szudy) - PDF|url=https://docplayer.pl/45420875-Fizyka-na-umk-kalendarium-szkic-projektowanego-tekstu-opracowal-prof-jozef-szudy.html|agency=docplayer.pl|accessdate=11 November 2019}}</ref> He became a full professor in 1992.<ref name="pr"/> 

Andrzej Kossakowski lectured at the universities in [[University of Stuttgart|Stuttgart]] (1973) [[University of Texas at Austin|Austin]] (1974), [[University of Milan|Milan]] (1975), [[Essen]] (1989), [[Catholic University of Leuven (1834–1968)|Leuven]] (1991),<ref name="pr"/> [[Naples]], [[Santiago|Santiago de Chile]], and [[Tokyo]].<ref name=":0">{{cite web|title=Fizyk kwantowy prof. Andrzej Kossakowski laureatem Narody FNP|url=http://naukawpolsce.pap.pl/aktualnosci/news%2C79304%2Cfizyk-kwantowy-prof-andrzej-kossakowski-laureatem-narody-fnp.html|agency=Nauka w Polsce|accessdate=11 November 2019|language=pl}}</ref>

He died in Toruń on 31 January 2021.<ref name="death">{{cite web|title=Prof. Andrzej Kossakowski |url=https://www.torun.pl/pl/zmarl-prof-andrzej-kossakowski |agency= Urząd Miasta Torunia |accessdate=1 February 2021|language=pl}}</ref>

==Recognition==
In 2019, Kossakowski received the [[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]] in the field of [[mathematics]], [[physics]], and [[engineering]] for his works on the theory of [[open quantum system]]s.<ref name=":0" />
